verdict.rationale: A national company registry holds filer data, so a user-facing control or policy against AI-training use is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 responses at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Blocking crawlers at the front door is an adjacent access control, not a documented user mechanism or policy preventing their data from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
